Bill Jones passed away recently at the age of 82. He was a keen member of the Club for over 30 years having previously been a member of Ashcombe AC for whom he raced with considerable success.

It was he who got Dennis Jones out at Dunsfold aerodrome when they won the silver in the National 5km road Championships. And every Sunday during the winter he gets Pat Newall to run with him from Clapham to Richmond, round the park and back!

Dennis Jones was next away and then came a short wait until a gaggle around the six-minute mark were sent off, Stuart among them and grinning like the Cheshire Cat as he rounded the turn at the end of Lauriston Road.

When he moved to Ursula Street he lived next door but one to Dennis Jones and his father Bill Jones. They were two life long Belgrave members, and it was they who persuaded Ted to join the club in February 1957.
Sadly, after a few years abroad he lost contact with them, as he did with John Dunsford and Dennis Jones, both of whom were responsible for his initial interest in running.
Also in the wars a little while back was Dennis Jones. At Wimbledon Station while heading for the Hall he was badly bitten on the hand by a dog.
